subject: rt-algn
title: RT.ALGN.------VT.DY.
description: Diagram in UPB(II)-22, directly after the passage where Braxton argues that 'the universal actualness of creativity is a factor that must be dealt with if we are to truly understand this consideration' and that many of us are 'left with no awareness about the composite thrust of world creativity — and this is unfortunate.' (C)RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is crossed with VT-DY (vibrational dynamics): the question is what reality alignment looks like when crossed with vibrational dynamics from the universal-philosophical perspective (rather than the cultural-particular perspective of v1-p377's NYM-11 reading). Besides the main line to VT-DY, two branches leave RT-ALGN. PROG-SIGN (progressional significance) carries PHY-U-C (physical universe context) → RT-IMP (reality implications), and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → TRS (transition). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) carries POL-DY (political dynamics), which branches to LANG-DY (language dynamics) and to INFO-DY (information dynamics) → IST-P.
